issue: Blocked task's Edit button is fully disabled, not partially restricted
actual: For blocked task "Complete tax filing", the Edit action button has the disabled attribute and cannot be clicked at all (confirmed via Playwright click timeout: element not enabled). Clicking the task title/card does not open any inline edit for description/priority either. So there is no way to modify description or priority while a task is blocked, contradicting the requirement that description and priority remain editable.

issue: Dependency connector line is not hoverable / no popup on hover
actual: A dashed SVG line with arrowheads does connect dependent tasks (stroke-dasharray, rendered behind cards), and each connector is wrapped in a Radix-like trigger group (data-state="closed", cursor-pointer). However this SVG overlay is stacked beneath the task cards and the small decorative stub divs (.bg-dashed-line) at every point in the layout, so a real mouse hover at the connector's only visible location (elementFromPoint at multiple card-boundary coordinates) always lands on the opaque stub/card element, never the SVG trigger. Playwright hover on the SVG g/path times out ("element is not visible"), and hovering the visible stub div directly produces no tooltip at all. As a result no dependency-chain popup is ever displayed when hovering the visual connection in practice.

Each task card shows title (h3) and priority badge; description paragraph and deadline are shown when supplied (e.g. "Review project proposal" shows description and "Aug 28" deadline); blocked tasks show a prerequisite warning badge; completed tasks render with "line-through text-muted-foreground" styling distinguishing them from active tasks.

"Complete tax filing" had complete.enabled=false while prerequisite "Review project proposal" was incomplete. After completing "Review project proposal", "Complete tax filing" became active/eligible (complete enabled) and was successfully marked completed.

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves its completed dependent simultaneously completed and blocked
actual: Completed "Complete tax filing" (dependent) while its prerequisite "Review project proposal" was also completed. Then reopened "Review project proposal" (unchecked its complete toggle) with no restriction or warning. Afterward, "Complete tax filing" remained in the Completed view (still marked completed, complete count stayed at 4, task did not reappear in Active view) while simultaneously showing a blocked-warning "Prerequisite \"Review project proposal\" incomplete" and having edit/complete disabled as a blocked task - i.e. it is both completed and blocked at once, which the constraint explicitly forbids. The system neither prevented the prerequisite reopening nor reverted the dependent task to a valid incomplete state.
